state:
Goal `core-math-2-3` is met: all thirteen members in its `--only` list carry every feature proof, and `bun nv proofs --verify --only …` prints `nothing owed`, `0 failed`, `0 failed`.
`Core\Math::fromBase` and `format` were the last two. Each has `about.md`, three examples, an attack, a bench and a `covers:` Rust test in `crates/nvs-stdlib/src/math.rs`'s test module, and each card is rewritten in the plain voice.
The `format` attack found a bug: a negative value that rounds to zero was written `-0` (`-0.4`, `-0.0`, `-0.004` at two decimals), where `number_format` writes `0`. It is fixed in `nvs_core_math_format` and pinned by `tests/differential/core/math-format-writes-no-sign-for-a-value-that-rounds-to-zero.nvst`.
`format(1.005, {decimals: 2})` is `1.00` where PHP writes `1.01`. That is not a bug: `tests/conformance/core/math-format-and-round-agree-wherever-both-name-the-same-precision.nvst` pins it, and `about.md` tells the reader to use a `decimal` when the digits must be exact.
Every Math perf record was re-measured after `math.rs` last moved; a later edit to that file makes them stale again and `bun nv proofs --record-perf --only <ids>` re-records them.
`format`'s bench counts 5 allocations per call, so it declares no `// bench: allocations` line.
